publicationGuardFinding.currentWrapperScope: The validated v2 wrapper takes only SH|NB on performance.lock and bounds the Node source/package process. It does not acquire publication.lock and does not bound or supervise subsequent native save/deploy/status calls.
unsafePatterns: Direct official Node helper waits for interactive JSON without its own input deadline.
Unbounded flock -x publication.lock or a lock keeper waiting forever for input/release.
Assuming source-wrapper exit unlocks a separate publication mutex or proves deployment terminal.
Unbounded deployment polling or a fresh save/deploy after an uncertain existing attempt.
publicationGuardFinding.requiredSupervisor: A separate minimal publication lease/supervisor is still required. Use one nonblocking acquisition of the existing publication mutex, a non-inheritable FD, a hard total deadline (proposed <=600s), durable sanitized initial/terminal receipts, catchable signal/finally cleanup and explicit release. Never recreate the mutex. The validated source wrapper remains unchanged and receives JSON before its own SH.
publicationGuardFinding.providerUncertainty: If a native provider operation outlives the lease or has an uncertain response, retain exact project/version/deployment IDs and an unresolved-operation record that blocks a new publication until reconciliation. Lease expiry is not evidence that the provider operation was cancelled. Never retry save blindly.
publicationGuardFinding.proposedPolling: Poll only pending/building/publishing, with a fixed small interval and the same absolute operation deadline. Stop on succeeded/failed. A succeeded result with URL requires no extra status/browser call.
publicationGuardFinding.privateRouting: If owner-only access is explicitly confirmed at publication time, use save_version_and_deploy_private once; otherwise preserve the current audience with save_site_version then deploy_site_version. A retained saved_version_id requires deploy-only recovery, never another save.
publicationGuardFinding.automaticPublicationRouting: The explicit save/deploy route applies only after automatic publish-on-push state has been reconciled. Preserve an already returned version/deployment ID; never duplicate an operation whose outcome is uncertain.
